verdict.rationale: A tax authority with an online filing and payment portal could plausibly offer event webhooks, for example for filing status or refund updates, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only interactive portal services, XML file uploads and online status-check tools, with no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. Probes found no OpenAPI spec, and the portal sits behind authenticated interactive sessions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
